title: Eight Bits of Trust; eMudhra's CA keys cracked in milliseconds
title_zh: 信任的八个比特；eMudhra 的 CA 密钥在几毫秒内被破解

paragraphs.en: One of eMudhra's certificate authority private keys is the number 4.
paragraphs.zh: eMudhra 的其中一个证书颁发机构私钥的编号是 4。

paragraphs.en: Not a number that starts with 4, or the number 4 followed by a few hundred random digits, just, 4... Another one is 56, and another is 115. I know, because I recovered all of them from their public certificates on my laptop just now, and it took less than a second.
paragraphs.zh: 不是一个以 4 开头的数字，也不是 4 后面跟着几百位随机数字的数，就是单纯的 4…… 另一个数是 56，还有一个是 115。 我知道这一点，因为我刚才从笔记本电脑上的公开证书中恢复了所有这些数字，整个过程用了不到一秒钟。

sents.en: Not a number that starts with 4, or the number 4 followed by a few hundred random digits, just, 4...
sents.zh: 不是一个以 4 开头的数字，也不是 4 后面跟着几百位随机数字的数，就是单纯的 4……

sents.en: Another one is 56, and another is 115.
sents.zh: 另一个数是 56，还有一个是 115。

sents.en: I know, because I recovered all of them from their public certificates on my laptop just now, and it took less than a second.
sents.zh: 我知道这一点，因为我刚才从笔记本电脑上的公开证书中恢复了所有这些数字，整个过程用了不到一秒钟。

paragraphs.en: On Saturday 17th October a security researcher reported to Apple, Google, Microsoft, Mozilla and eMudhra that the private keys for eight eMudhra intermediate certificates were compromised. Chrome pushed a CRLSet update blocking them that evening and Mozilla blocked them in Firefox via OneCRL a few hours later. On Tuesday 20th, Mozilla announced it publicly and shipped an NSS update removing the eMudhra root, and Chrome confirmed the root is going in Chrome Root Store v43.
paragraphs.zh: 10月17日星期六，一名安全研究员向 Apple、Google、Microsoft、Mozilla 和 eMudhra 报告称，eMudhra 八张中间证书的私钥已遭泄露。 当天晚上 Chrome 推送了 CRLSet 更新将这些证书封锁，几小时后 Mozilla 也通过 OneCRL 在 Firefox 中封锁了它们。 10月20日星期二，Mozilla 公开宣布了此事，并发布了一项移除 eMudhra 根证书的 NSS 更新，Chrome 也确认该根证书将被移入 Chrome 根证书库 v43 中处理。

sents.en: On Saturday 17th October a security researcher reported to Apple, Google, Microsoft, Mozilla and eMudhra that the private keys for eight eMudhra intermediate certificates were compromised.
sents.zh: 10月17日星期六，一名安全研究员向 Apple、Google、Microsoft、Mozilla 和 eMudhra 报告称，eMudhra 八张中间证书的私钥已遭泄露。

sents.en: Chrome pushed a CRLSet update blocking them that evening and Mozilla blocked them in Firefox via OneCRL a few hours later.
sents.zh: 当天晚上 Chrome 推送了 CRLSet 更新将这些证书封锁，几小时后 Mozilla 也通过 OneCRL 在 Firefox 中封锁了它们。

sents.en: On Tuesday 20th, Mozilla announced it publicly and shipped an NSS update removing the eMudhra root, and Chrome confirmed the root is going in Chrome Root Store v43.
sents.zh: 10月20日星期二，Mozilla 公开宣布了此事，并发布了一项移除 eMudhra 根证书的 NSS 更新，Chrome 也确认该根证书将被移入 Chrome 根证书库 v43 中处理。

paragraphs.en: The eight intermediates are six TLS issuing CAs (DV, OV and EV, two generations each) and two code-signing CAs, all created in April 2025. Every one of them was also cross-signed by Sectigo's AAA Certificate Services root in May 2025.
paragraphs.zh: 这八个中间证书是六个TLS签发CA（DV、OV和EV，各有两代）和两个代码签名CA，全部创建于2025年4月。 它们中的每一个还都在2025年5月由Sectigo的AAA Certificate Services根证书交叉签名。

sents.en: The eight intermediates are six TLS issuing CAs (DV, OV and EV, two generations each) and two code-signing CAs, all created in April 2025.
sents.zh: 这八个中间证书是六个TLS签发CA（DV、OV和EV，各有两代）和两个代码签名CA，全部创建于2025年4月。

sents.en: Every one of them was also cross-signed by Sectigo's AAA Certificate Services root in May 2025.
sents.zh: 它们中的每一个还都在2025年5月由Sectigo的AAA Certificate Services根证书交叉签名。

paragraphs.en: That's the "what", but it's the "how" that's the interesting part, and it was summed up in one line on the thread by Ian Carroll:
paragraphs.zh: 这就是“是什么”，但真正有意思的是“怎么做”，Ian Carroll 在该讨论帖中用一句话对此进行了概括：

paragraphs.en: These are elliptic-curve keys on the P-384 curve. The private key is just a number, d . The public key, the thing that goes in the certificate for the world to see, is d × G , where G is a fixed point on the curve that everyone uses and "×" means adding G to itself d times using the curve's special arithmetic.
paragraphs.zh: 这些是 P-384 曲线上的椭圆曲线密钥。 私钥只是一个数 d。 公钥，也就是放进证书里供全世界查看的东西，是 d × G，其中 G 是曲线上所有人都使用的固定点，而「×」表示使用该曲线的特殊运算将 G 自身相加 d 次。

sents.en: These are elliptic-curve keys on the P-384 curve.
sents.zh: 这些是 P-384 曲线上的椭圆曲线密钥。

sents.en: The private key is just a number, d .
sents.zh: 私钥只是一个数 d。

sents.en: The public key, the thing that goes in the certificate for the world to see, is d × G , where G is a fixed point on the curve that everyone uses and "×" means adding G to itself d times using the curve's special arithmetic.
sents.zh: 公钥，也就是放进证书里供全世界查看的东西，是 d × G，其中 G 是曲线上所有人都使用的固定点，而「×」表示使用该曲线的特殊运算将 G 自身相加 d 次。

paragraphs.en: Going forwards is easy, but going backwards, from the public key to d , is considered to be impractical. That's the entire security model, and it only holds if d is enormous. A P-384 private key should be a random 384-bit number, which gives you 2³⁸⁴ possibilities (or roughly 10¹¹⁵), so nobody is ever going to search that.
paragraphs.zh: 从私钥推出公钥很容易，但反其道而行之，即从公钥推导出 d，则被认为是不切实际的。 这就是整套安全模型，而它只有在 d 非常巨大时才成立。 P-384 私钥应当是一个随机的 384 位数字，这会给出 2³⁸⁴ 种可能性（大约 10¹¹⁵），所以没有人会去搜索这么大的空间。

sents.en: Going forwards is easy, but going backwards, from the public key to d , is considered to be impractical.
sents.zh: 从私钥推出公钥很容易，但反其道而行之，即从公钥推导出 d，则被认为是不切实际的。

sents.en: That's the entire security model, and it only holds if d is enormous.
sents.zh: 这就是整套安全模型，而它只有在 d 非常巨大时才成立。

sents.en: A P-384 private key should be a random 384-bit number, which gives you 2³⁸⁴ possibilities (or roughly 10¹¹⁵), so nobody is ever going to search that.
sents.zh: P-384 私钥应当是一个随机的 384 位数字，这会给出 2³⁸⁴ 种可能性（大约 10¹¹⁵），所以没有人会去搜索这么大的空间。

paragraphs.en: That's 47 bytes of zeros and then one byte, and all eight keys are like that. A single byte has 256 possible values, so the "search" is: compute 1 × G , 2 × G , 3 × G , and stop when it matches the certificate, which is at most 255 steps.
paragraphs.zh: 那是 47 个字节的零然后一个字节，而且所有八个密钥都是那样。 单个字节有 256 种可能的取值，所以这个「搜索」就是：计算 1 × G、2 × G、3 × G，直到匹配到证书为止，最多 255 步。

sents.en: That's 47 bytes of zeros and then one byte, and all eight keys are like that.
sents.zh: 那是 47 个字节的零然后一个字节，而且所有八个密钥都是那样。

sents.en: A single byte has 256 possible values, so the "search" is: compute 1 × G , 2 × G , 3 × G , and stop when it matches the certificate, which is at most 255 steps.
sents.zh: 单个字节有 256 种可能的取值，所以这个「搜索」就是：计算 1 × G、2 × G、3 × G，直到匹配到证书为止，最多 255 步。

paragraphs.en: So the whole thing, every certificate those CAs could ever issue, every client that trusted them, rested on eight bits.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，整个体系——那些 CA 曾能签发的每一张证书、每一个信任它们的客户端——都系于八个比特之上。

paragraphs.en: Mozilla attached the affected certificates to their announcement, so I pulled all 16 (8 keys, each used in two issued certificates: once by eMudhra and once by Sectigo) and brute-forced them. Every single one fell over instantly, the six TLS values, and the two code-signing keys are just as weak:
paragraphs.zh: Mozilla 在其公告中附上了受影响的证书，因此我提取了全部 16 份（8 个密钥，每个密钥用于两份已签发的证书：一份由 eMudhra 签发，一份由 Sectigo 签发）并对其进行了暴力破解。 每一个都在瞬间被破解，六个 TLS 值和两个代码签名密钥同样脆弱：

sents.en: Mozilla attached the affected certificates to their announcement, so I pulled all 16 (8 keys, each used in two issued certificates: once by eMudhra and once by Sectigo) and brute-forced them.
sents.zh: Mozilla 在其公告中附上了受影响的证书，因此我提取了全部 16 份（8 个密钥，每个密钥用于两份已签发的证书：一份由 eMudhra 签发，一份由 Sectigo 签发）并对其进行了暴力破解。

sents.en: Every single one fell over instantly, the six TLS values, and the two code-signing keys are just as weak:
sents.zh: 每一个都在瞬间被破解，六个 TLS 值和两个代码签名密钥同样脆弱：

paragraphs.en: It's interesting that nothing about these certificates looks wrong. A public key derived from d = 4 is a perfectly valid point on the curve, the encoding is fine, the curve is fine, every structural check passes. The only way to find out is to try.
paragraphs.zh: 有趣的是，这些证书没有任何看起来不对的地方。 由 d = 4 推导出的公钥是曲线上一完全有效的点，编码没问题，曲线也没问题，每一项结构性检查都能通过。 唯一能查明的方法就是去尝试。

sents.en: It's interesting that nothing about these certificates looks wrong.
sents.zh: 有趣的是，这些证书没有任何看起来不对的地方。

sents.en: A public key derived from d = 4 is a perfectly valid point on the curve, the encoding is fine, the curve is fine, every structural check passes.
sents.zh: 由 d = 4 推导出的公钥是曲线上一完全有效的点，编码没问题，曲线也没问题，每一项结构性检查都能通过。

sents.en: The only way to find out is to try.
sents.zh: 唯一能查明的方法就是去尝试。

paragraphs.en: Normally when a CA key is compromised, someone stole it! There's a thief, there's a moment it happened, and you can at least reason about who now has access to that key.
paragraphs.zh: 通常情况下，当一个 CA 密钥被泄露时，是有人把它偷走了！ 有窃贼，有案发时刻，你至少可以推断出现在谁能使用该密钥。

sents.en: Normally when a CA key is compromised, someone stole it!
sents.zh: 通常情况下，当一个 CA 密钥被泄露时，是有人把它偷走了！

sents.en: There's a thief, there's a moment it happened, and you can at least reason about who now has access to that key.
sents.zh: 有窃贼，有案发时刻，你至少可以推断出现在谁能使用该密钥。

paragraphs.en: Here, nobody had to steal anything. The key was effectively public from the day the certificate existed. Anyone who looked at one of these certificates, at any point since April 2025, could have recovered the key in milliseconds on commodity hardware. That's a 17 month window and there is no way to know whether someone did.
paragraphs.zh: 在这里，没有人需要窃取任何东西。 从证书诞生之日起，这把密钥实际上就是公开的。 自 2025 年 4 月以来的任何时候，任何看过这些证书之一的人，都可以在普通硬件上于几毫秒内恢复出这把密钥。 这是一个长达 17 个月的窗口期，而且无法知道是否有人真的这样做了。

sents.en: Here, nobody had to steal anything.
sents.zh: 在这里，没有人需要窃取任何东西。

sents.en: The key was effectively public from the day the certificate existed.
sents.zh: 从证书诞生之日起，这把密钥实际上就是公开的。

sents.en: Anyone who looked at one of these certificates, at any point since April 2025, could have recovered the key in milliseconds on commodity hardware.
sents.zh: 自 2025 年 4 月以来的任何时候，任何看过这些证书之一的人，都可以在普通硬件上于几毫秒内恢复出这把密钥。

sents.en: That's a 17 month window and there is no way to know whether someone did.
sents.zh: 这是一个长达 17 个月的窗口期，而且无法知道是否有人真的这样做了。

paragraphs.en: Chrome made the point that because Chrome enforces Certificate Transparency, and no TLS certificates chaining to these CAs ever showed up in CT, no forged certificate could have been trusted by default in Chrome. That's true and it's reassuring for browsers. CT detects mis-issuance though, it doesn't prevent it, and a lot of software doesn't check CT at all.
paragraphs.zh: Chrome 指出，由于 Chrome 强制执行证书透明度（Certificate Transparency），而链到这些证书颁发机构的 TLS 证书从未出现在 CT 日志中，因此任何伪造的证书在 Chrome 中默认都不可能被信任。 这是对的，对浏览器来说是令人放心的。 不过 CT 只是检测错误签发，并不能阻止错误签发，而且很多软件根本不检查 CT。

sents.en: Chrome made the point that because Chrome enforces Certificate Transparency, and no TLS certificates chaining to these CAs ever showed up in CT, no forged certificate could have been trusted by default in Chrome.
sents.zh: Chrome 指出，由于 Chrome 强制执行证书透明度（Certificate Transparency），而链到这些证书颁发机构的 TLS 证书从未出现在 CT 日志中，因此任何伪造的证书在 Chrome 中默认都不可能被信任。

sents.en: That's true and it's reassuring for browsers.
sents.zh: 这是对的，对浏览器来说是令人放心的。

sents.en: CT detects mis-issuance though, it doesn't prevent it, and a lot of software doesn't check CT at all.
sents.zh: 不过 CT 只是检测错误签发，并不能阻止错误签发，而且很多软件根本不检查 CT。

paragraphs.en: Mainstream and updated browsers are likely absolutely fine. Chrome and Firefox block the intermediates directly and both require CT, and Safari requires CT too.
paragraphs.zh: 主流且更新及时的浏览器大概率完全没问题。 Chrome 和 Firefox 直接阻止中间证书，且两者都要求 CT，Safari 也要求 CT。

sents.en: Mainstream and updated browsers are likely absolutely fine.
sents.zh: 主流且更新及时的浏览器大概率完全没问题。

sents.en: Chrome and Firefox block the intermediates directly and both require CT, and Safari requires CT too.
sents.zh: Chrome 和 Firefox 直接阻止中间证书，且两者都要求 CT，Safari 也要求 CT。

paragraphs.en: Everything else is a different story, though. Most non-browser TLS clients (so basically everything else, with default settings), things like curl, Python, Node, Go, Java, git, package managers and every script and daemon you've got, do three things that matter here: they trust a CA bundle on disk, they don't check revocation by default, and they don't check CT. So the fact that eMudhra and Sectigo have revoked these intermediates doesn't help them at all. This is something that I find often when talking about TLS and PKI, understanding just how massive the client ecosystem is can be overlooked. We often focus on this in training when we look at modern solutions for revocation like CRLite, which works wonders on the desktop browsers, but does nothing for any other TLS client. Consider what needs its root store updating now, and this is just the tip of the iceberg:
paragraphs.zh: 不过，其他一切情况就另当别论了。 大多数非浏览器 TLS 客户端（基本上就是默认设置下的其他所有客户端），比如 curl、Python、Node、Go、Java、git、包管理器以及你拥有的每一个脚本和守护进程，都会做三件与此相关的重要事情：它们信任磁盘上的 CA 证书包，默认不检查吊销状态，也不检查 CT。 因此，eMudhra 和 Sectigo 吊销这些中间证书的事实对它们毫无帮助。 这是我在谈论 TLS 和 PKI 时经常发现的一点：人们往往会忽视客户端生态系统究竟有多庞大。 在培训中，当我们讨论像 CRLite 这样的现代吊销解决方案时，我们经常关注这一点：它在桌面浏览器上效果奇佳，但对任何其他 TLS 客户端却毫无作用。 想想现在有哪些东西需要更新其根证书存储，而这还只是冰山一角：

paragraphs.en: I tested this on my own machines using a local server and a certificate for api.stripe.com , a name that we can all likely agree is very high value. With default settings, curl said SSL certificate verify ok , Python completed the handshake, and Node said authorized: true . That was true on every Linux and macOS machine I tested. On Windows, CryptoAPI accepted the chain unless revocation checking was switched on, and even then only one of the two routes came back as revoked.
paragraphs.zh: 我在自己的机器上使用本地服务器和一个 api.stripe.com 的证书进行了测试，这个名字我们大概都会认同价值极高。 在默认设置下，curl 显示 SSL certificate verify ok，Python 完成了握手，Node 则显示 authorized: true。 在我测试过的每台 Linux 和 macOS 机器上情况都是如此。 在 Windows 上，除非开启了吊销检查，否则 CryptoAPI 会接受该证书链，即便开启了，两条路由中也只有一条返回已吊销的结果。

sents.en: I tested this on my own machines using a local server and a certificate for api.stripe.com , a name that we can all likely agree is very high value.
sents.zh: 我在自己的机器上使用本地服务器和一个 api.stripe.com 的证书进行了测试，这个名字我们大概都会认同价值极高。

sents.en: With default settings, curl said SSL certificate verify ok , Python completed the handshake, and Node said authorized: true .
sents.zh: 在默认设置下，curl 显示 SSL certificate verify ok，Python 完成了握手，Node 则显示 authorized: true。

sents.en: That was true on every Linux and macOS machine I tested.
sents.zh: 在我测试过的每台 Linux 和 macOS 机器上情况都是如此。

sents.en: On Windows, CryptoAPI accepted the chain unless revocation checking was switched on, and even then only one of the two routes came back as revoked.
sents.zh: 在 Windows 上，除非开启了吊销检查，否则 CryptoAPI 会接受该证书链，即便开启了，两条路由中也只有一条返回已吊销的结果。

paragraphs.en: You can put any other hostname you want in that certificate and you have everything you need to intercept that device's traffic, all you have to do is get on the network path.
paragraphs.zh: 你可以在该证书中放入任何你想要的主机名，这样就拥有了拦截该设备流量所需的一切，你只需处在网络路径上即可。

paragraphs.en: It's fortunate that the steps required here aren't particularly complicated for the devices you can update, and the advice essentially boils down to 'update them'. The problem is the devices you can't update or update easily.
paragraphs.zh: 幸运的是，对于你可以更新的设备，这里所需的步骤并不特别复杂，建议基本上可以归结为“更新它们”。 问题在于那些你无法更新或难以轻松更新的设备。

sents.en: The problem is the devices you can't update or update easily.
sents.zh: 问题在于那些你无法更新或难以轻松更新的设备。

paragraphs.en: Eight bits. For 17 whole months, that's all that stood between a huge amount of non-browser software and a forged certificate for any site blowing the security on all of your encrypted traffic.
paragraphs.zh: 八个比特。 在整整17个月里，这短短八个比特就是大量的非浏览器软件与一张伪造证书之间的全部屏障——那张证书可以为任何网站伪造身份，从而破解你所有加密流量的安全。

paragraphs.en: Update 20th Oct 2026 20:16 UTC Shortly after publishing, Mozilla made their incident ticket public: https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=2083449
paragraphs.zh: 2026年10月20日 20:16 UTC 更新 发布后不久，Mozilla 公开了他们的事件工单：https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=2083449

paragraphs.en: eMudhra have given their account of what happened on that ticket. It seems there was a bug in the script used during the ceremony, a second, weak key pair was created on the HSM, and having similar names a human error lead to the wrong keys being used for the CSR. Nothing in the text of my article above has changed as a result of this new information. I can also confirm that a simple prompt in an AI agent allowed me to recover the private keys of the CA. Claude was able to recover the private keys with a single prompt.
paragraphs.zh: eMudhra 已经就那张工单上发生的情况给出了他们的说明。 看起来是在仪式期间使用的脚本中存在一个缺陷，HSM 上生成了第二对弱密钥，由于名称相似，人为错误导致错误的密钥被用于 CSR。 上文我文章的内容并未因这一新信息而发生任何变化。 我还可以确认，在 AI 智能体中只需一个简单的提示，就让我恢复了 CA 的私钥。 Claude 仅用一条提示就恢复了私钥。

sents.zh: 上文我文章的内容并未因这一新信息而发生任何变化。

sents.en: I can also confirm that a simple prompt in an AI agent allowed me to recover the private keys of the CA.
sents.zh: 我还可以确认，在 AI 智能体中只需一个简单的提示，就让我恢复了 CA 的私钥。
